paragraphs: Rav Shalom. Rabbah, Emor chapter 26, in R' Aha bar R' Zeira's name. Heilprin also cites Tanhuma, Vayera, for a teaching in R' Yuda bar R' Simon’s name. The checked Tanhuma gives R' Yehudah bar R' Shalom as the transmitter. Gilgulei Neshamot writes in the Ari's name that Hosea 9, ‘The days of reckoning have come; the days of payment have come,’ refers to R' Shalom and hints at R' Shalom's episode. I do not know the episode of R' Shalom.
